description: Drugs in municipal wastewater in selected European and international cities is a dataset listed in European Union Drugs Agency, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by European Monitoring Centre for Drugs and Drug Addiction. Analysing communal wastewaters for drugs and their metabolic products in order to estimate their consumption in the community is a developing field, involving scientists working in different research areas, including analytical chemistry, physiology and biochemistry, sewage engineering, spatial epidemiology and statistics, and conventional drug epidemiology. Coverage: European Monitoring Centre for Drugs and Drug Addiction. The publisher named on the listing is European Monitoring Centre for Drugs and Drug Addiction. Its keywords include cannabis, cocaine, MDMA/ecstasy, wastewater, ketamine, methamphetamine. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is European Commission reuse notice. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-emcdda.
